name: fs25-xml
description: Autocomplete + validation for Farming Simulator 25 mod XML (vehicle, placeable, map, modDesc, …) with valid-value dropdowns the stock docs hide: jointType, fillType, fruitType, particleType, effectClass, rigidBodyType, inputAction, brand, store category, material templates.

commands.title: FS25: Apply enriched schema to current XML file
FS25: Repoint all stock schema refs in workspace to enriched
FS25: Insert/repoint schema reference in current file

fs25xml.autoBindOnOpen.description: When a file has NO schema reference, bind the matching enriched schema via xml.fileAssociations (no file edit).

fs25xml.autoRepointOnOpen.description: When a file references a stock GIANTS schema (relative path or the giants-software validation URL), rewrite that reference to the enriched schema on open. This edits and saves the file.

fs25xml.schemaDir.description: Absolute path to the enriched schemas folder. Leave empty to use the schemas bundled in this extension. Set it to a stable path (e.g. .../FS25_ResearchProject/schemas) so repointed refs survive extension updates.
